classes.name: Hoplite
classes.subtitle: Phalangite Heavy Infantry
classes.description: Disciplined heavy infantry fighter specialising in heavy bronze armour, shield defence, spear combat, and protective battlefield formations.

classFeatures.name: Aspis Phalanx Wall
classFeatures.desc: +2 Armor Class when wielding a shield.

classFeatures.name: Dory Piercing Thrust
classFeatures.desc: Bypasses 2 points of enemy armor class on melee spear strikes.

classFeatures.name: Steadfast Discipline
classFeatures.desc: Immunity to fear and panic effects from monstrous creatures.

classFeatures.name: Othismos Shield Push
classFeatures.desc: Staggers enemy with shield boss, reducing their attack bonus by 2 for 2 turns.

classFeatures.name: Promachos Vanguard
classFeatures.desc: +4 Max Health, +2 Max Stamina, and critical hit threat expanded to 19-20 with spears.

classes.name: Hypaspist
classes.subtitle: Wrestling Hero & Pankration Master
classes.description: Agile close-combat fighter inspired by Heracles and Theseus, specialising in unarmed pankration, grappling throws, short-range weapons, and sheer physical power.

classFeatures.name: Iron Grip Pankration
classFeatures.desc: Unarmed strikes deal 1d6+Str damage and can grapple foes.

classFeatures.name: Heraclean Throw
classFeatures.desc: Hurl an enemy into the dirt, inflicting bludgeoning damage and forcing a recovery round.

classFeatures.name: Calloused Thews
classFeatures.desc: Base AC gains +2 from unyielding muscle even when unarmored.

classFeatures.name: Lion's Stranglehold
classFeatures.desc: Immobilize a humanoid or beast, denying their turn on a successful Strength contest.

classFeatures.name: Olympic Might
classFeatures.desc: Strength checks gain advantage; critical hits deal triple unarmed damage.

classes.name: Amazon
classes.subtitle: Shield-Maiden of Artemis
classes.description: Mobile wilderness warrior associated with Artemis, specialising in archery, tracking, mobility, evasion, and predatory creature hunting.

classFeatures.name: Eye of the Huntress
classFeatures.desc: +2 attack bonus with ranged bows; night darkness imposes no penalty.

classFeatures.name: Swift Skirmish Stride
classFeatures.desc: Moving across rough or mountain terrain costs 25% less stamina.

classFeatures.name: Artemisian Arrow Flurry
classFeatures.desc: Unleash two rapid bow shots in a single combat round.

classFeatures.name: Slayer of Monsters
classFeatures.desc: +3 bonus damage against beasts, mythical monsters, and serpents.

classFeatures.name: Goddess's Huntress Grace
classFeatures.desc: Evasion AC +2; naturally rolls Arete (20) on 19 or 20 for ranged skill checks.

classes.name: Myrmidon
classes.subtitle: Achillean Berserker
classes.description: Relentless frontline warrior inspired by Achilles' ant-born elite, specialising in aggressive battle frenzy, overwhelming offensive speed, and frontline dominance.

classFeatures.name: Achillean Frenzy
classFeatures.desc: Enter battle frenzy for 3 rounds: +3 weapon damage, -1 AC.

classFeatures.name: Relentless Assault
classFeatures.desc: Defeating an opponent immediately grants a free strike on adjacent enemies.

classFeatures.name: Blood-Tide Surge
classFeatures.desc: When below 40% Health, attack rolls gain +2 and morale is unbreakable.

classFeatures.name: Spear of Phthia
classFeatures.desc: Deliver a devastating thrust that pierces deep, causing heavy bleeding.

classFeatures.name: Legendary Wrath
classFeatures.desc: +10 Max Health; weapon strikes add +4 bonus damage.

classes.name: Trickster
classes.subtitle: Mountebank & Cunning Wayfarer
classes.description: Cunning character inspired by Odysseus and Hermes, specialising in deception, persuasion, disguises, misdirection, opportunistic combat, and theft.

classFeatures.name: Hermetic Sleight
classFeatures.desc: +3 bonus on lockpicking and pickpocketing checks; tools never snap on natural 2-5.

classFeatures.name: Feint & Strike
classFeatures.desc: Deceive an opponent in combat, rendering them flat-footed (-4 AC) against your next blow.

classFeatures.name: Silvertongue Bargain
classFeatures.desc: Merchant prices reduced by 15%; persuasion checks gain +2.

classFeatures.name: Smoke & Mirror Exit
classFeatures.desc: Flee from combat with 100% guarantee without sustaining opportunity damage.

classFeatures.name: Odyssean Guile
classFeatures.desc: All skill checks involving deception, stealth, or puzzles gain +4.

classes.name: Oracle's Shadow
classes.subtitle: Temple Operative & Spy
classes.description: Stealth specialist and confidential operative associated with political courts and sanctuaries, specialising in information gathering, ambushes, and precision attacks.

classFeatures.name: Shadow Veil
classFeatures.desc: +3 bonus on stealth checks; impossible to surprise when resting.

classFeatures.name: Anatomical Precision
classFeatures.desc: Strikes from stealth deal double maximum weapon damage.

classFeatures.name: Court Secrets
classFeatures.desc: Unlocks hidden political and faction dialogue choices with all rulers.

classFeatures.name: Silencing Strike
classFeatures.desc: Strike the throat, preventing the target from sounding an alarm or casting spells.

classFeatures.name: Ghost of the Adyton
classFeatures.desc: Can move silently across any terrain; stealth checks roll with advantage.

classes.name: Labyrinth Runner
classes.subtitle: Explorer & Ruin Pathfinder
classes.description: Pathfinder specialising in dangerous underground complexes and ancient ruins, skilled in navigation, trap disarming, and environmental survival.

classFeatures.name: Dungeon Sense
classFeatures.desc: Detect traps and secret fissures automatically upon entering subterranean rooms.

classFeatures.name: Ariadne's Thread
classFeatures.desc: Immunity to becoming lost in caves or mazes; backtracking costs zero stamina.

classFeatures.name: Tumbler Expert
classFeatures.desc: +4 bonus on all lockpicking and trap disarming checks.

classFeatures.name: Vault Breaker
classFeatures.desc: Heave boulders and heavy stone obstacles with +4 effective Strength.

classFeatures.name: Master of Ancient Tombs
classFeatures.desc: Dungeon loot yields +25% additional drachmae and gems.

classes.name: Demigod
classes.subtitle: Scion of Mount Olympus
classes.description: Mortal hero inheriting blood from an Olympian deity (Zeus, Poseidon, Hades, Athena, Apollo), wielding innate divine power and celestial endurance.

classFeatures.name: Olympian Sparks
classFeatures.desc: Channel divine lineage to unleash celestial burst (+1d8 elemental damage).

classFeatures.name: Ichor of the Gods
classFeatures.desc: +5 Max Health; recover 1 HP every 3 rounds in combat.

classFeatures.name: Aura of Majesty
classFeatures.desc: +2 bonus on all Charisma checks and faction negotiations.

classFeatures.name: Heavenly Aegis
classFeatures.desc: Summon a radiant aura that absorbs the next 15 points of damage.

classFeatures.name: Ascendant Spark
classFeatures.desc: +2 to all primary attributes; divine favor can be invoked twice per day.

classes.name: Oracle
classes.subtitle: Pythian Seer & Prophet
classes.description: Mystic connected to prophecy and divine omens, using foresight to anticipate danger, divine secrets, and grant supernatural foresight to allies.

classFeatures.name: Prescient Foresight
classFeatures.desc: Gain +2 initiative and +1 Armor Class by anticipating opponent strikes.

classFeatures.name: Visions of Truth
classFeatures.desc: Reveal hidden dialogue intentions, motives, and vulnerabilities of NPCs.

classFeatures.name: Fateful Redirection
classFeatures.desc: Force an attacker to reroll a successful strike against you once per combat.

classFeatures.name: Pythian Trance
classFeatures.desc: Receive cryptic clues directly into the journal regarding active quest mysteries.

classFeatures.name: Voice of Apollo
classFeatures.desc: Natural 20 (Arete) threat expanded on all Wisdom and Perception checks.

classes.name: Philosopher
classes.subtitle: Logic-Mage & Natural Scholar
classes.description: Scholar whose supernatural abilities are rooted in mathematics, natural philosophy, rhetoric, and understanding the harmonious principles of the cosmos.

classFeatures.name: Syllogistic Analysis
classFeatures.desc: Identify monster weaknesses and armor vulnerabilities upon encountering them.

classFeatures.name: Dialectical Refutation
classFeatures.desc: Disconcert an opponent with rhetorical axioms, penalizing their attacks by 2.

classFeatures.name: Harmonic Geometry
classFeatures.desc: +3 bonus on all puzzle deciphering and architectural investigation checks.

classFeatures.name: Elemental Alchemy
classFeatures.desc: Synthesize rapid alchemical reagents in combat without consuming ingredients.

classFeatures.name: Cosmic Archē
classFeatures.desc: Intelligence modifier is added directly to all spell/alchemical damage.

classes.name: Mystery Cultist
classes.subtitle: Eleusinian Theurgist
classes.description: Initiate into the sacred Eleusinian and Orphic traditions, manipulating sacred rites, spiritual communion, and the eternal cycle of life, death, and rebirth.

classFeatures.name: Eleusinian Rite
classFeatures.desc: Resting restores 50% more health and stamina through meditative purification.

classFeatures.name: Chthonic Ward
classFeatures.desc: Erect a sacred barrier that reduces necrotic, cold, and poison damage by half.

classFeatures.name: Communion with Shades
classFeatures.desc: Speak with the spirits of slain NPCs or heroes to extract lost secrets.

classFeatures.name: Harvest Renewal
classFeatures.desc: Heal 15 Health during combat by invoking Demeter and Persephone.

classFeatures.name: Initiate of Eternity
classFeatures.desc: Upon suffering fatal damage, automatically revive at 1 HP once per full rest.

classes.name: Nymph-Bound
classes.subtitle: Dryad-Sworn Nature Guardian
classes.description: Primal wilderness guardian connected to sacred ash groves, springs, and naiads, commanding plant growth, wild fauna, and pure spring healing.

classFeatures.name: Bramble Tangle
classFeatures.desc: Cause thorny briars to erupt from the soil, immobilizing an enemy.

classFeatures.name: Spring of Naiads
classFeatures.desc: Draw pure healing water from the ground, cleansing poisons and restoring 8 HP.

classFeatures.name: Commune with Fauna
classFeatures.desc: Wild beasts and boars will not attack unless provoked.

classFeatures.name: Barkskin Aegis
classFeatures.desc: Harden your flesh with living oak bark (+3 Armor Class for 4 rounds).

classFeatures.name: Sacred Grove Lord
classFeatures.desc: +4 bonus on all herbalism and gathering rolls; herbal consumables double potency.

classes.name: Tide-Caller
classes.subtitle: Aegean Navigator & Sea Shaper
classes.description: Mariner and mystical navigator attuned to Poseidon, commanding oceanic tides, salt winds, sea-creature empathy, and tempestuous marine magic.

classFeatures.name: Trident Mastery
classFeatures.desc: +2 damage when wielding tridents or polearms; maritime travel costs half stamina.

classFeatures.name: Salt Wave Crash
classFeatures.desc: Summon a crashing wave of seawater that knocks opponents prone.

classFeatures.name: Gale-Force Tailwind
classFeatures.desc: Travel speed across all regions increased by 20%.

classFeatures.name: Wrath of the Earth-Shaker
classFeatures.desc: Shake the ground beneath opponents, inflicting 2d8 seismic damage.

classFeatures.name: Master of the Aegean
classFeatures.desc: Water and cold damage reduced by 50%; trident attacks ignore 4 enemy AC.

classes.name: Maenad
classes.subtitle: Bacchant of Dionysus
classes.description: Wild and unpredictable devotee of Dionysus, wielding ecstatic frenzy, chaotic thyrsoi strikes, sensory illusions, and unyielding resistance to restraint.

classFeatures.name: Dionysian Ecstasy
classFeatures.desc: Enter wild trance: gain +2 attack, +2 damage, and complete immunity to stun/fear.

classFeatures.name: Ivy Thyrsus Strike
classFeatures.desc: Blunt weapons inflict vine entanglements that reduce enemy Agility.

classFeatures.name: Frenzied Resilience
classFeatures.desc: Suffering a blow increases attack bonus by +1 on your following strike.

classFeatures.name: Madness of Bacchus
classFeatures.desc: Confuse an enemy with intoxicating illusions, causing them to strike allies.

classFeatures.name: Immortal Revelry
classFeatures.desc: Drinking wine heals 20 Health and immediately cures all negative conditions.
